messages:
jess_support: Customer (AcmeHealth) opened a ticket — invoice token total for 2026-03-10 is 3,217,842 but their on-prem 'edge-collector' ledger only shows ~2,912,140. They see a window with anomalies 03:05-04:20 UTC. Can we triage?

jess_support: Customer quote pasted: "we hit disk pressure and restarted the collector at ~03:40; after that we see events flowing but total on our side doesn't match the invoice. can you help reconcile?"

sam_sre: Got it. First-pass: sounds like seq gaps + possible dropped events during restart. Ask for agent logs + ledger.db + audit export. Also check agent vs billing clock offset.

lia_devops: Requested these artifacts from customer. Also ask them to run the lightweight check below and paste output: 
```
# on the collector host
date -u +%s
ls -lh /var/lib/edge-collector/ledger.db
sqlite3 /var/lib/edge-collector/ledger.db "SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(tokens) FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-03-10T03:00:00Z' AND timestamp < '2026-03-10T04:30:00Z';"
```

jess_support: Customer sent logs and ledger dump links. Key log snippets they've attached: 
```
2026-03-10T03:12:04Z edge-collector[212] INFO persisted seq=109872 tokens=8213
2026-03-10T03:54:09Z edge-collector[212] WARN disk_write_error: no space left, buffering to /tmp
2026-03-10T03:56:01Z edge-collector[212] INFO restart triggered by OOM, replay queue size=12411
2026-03-10T04:01:00Z edge-collector[212] INFO replayed seq=110995 tokens=4120 duplicate_suppression=skipped
```

sam_sre: Those logs show disk pressure then restart then replay. Two immediate things: 1) optimistic ack mode may have acked upstream before fsync/persist, 2) duplicate suppression flagged as skipped during replay — likely sequence rewriting or missing seq metadata.

lia_devops: I ran the initial sqlite checks on the ledger dump. Ledger tokens for window = 2912140 (matches customer local). Audit export tokens for same window = 3217842 (matches invoice). Delta = +305702 tokens.

tom_billing: Noted. We'll need formal artifact upload to ticket and a short reconciliation doc. If confirmed we can grant a provisional credit while investigation continues. Please include how many of the delta are from the exact 03:05-04:20 window.

jess_support: Commands I supplied to the customer to produce reconciliations (internal tools):
```
# count tokens in ledger by time range
rw-usage-recon --ledger /var/lib/edge-collector/ledger.db --from 2026-03-10T03:00:00Z --to 2026-03-10T04:30:00Z --sum-tokens
# export audit rows from console
rw-audit-export --start=2026-03-10T03:00:00Z --end=2026-03-10T04:30:00Z --format=csv | gzip > audit-window-0300-0430.csv.gz
```

sam_sre: A few investigative SQLs we should run on ledger.db to look for collisions/gaps: 
```
# find seq gaps
sqlite3 ledger.db "WITH c AS (SELECT seq, lead(seq) OVER (ORDER BY seq) AS next_seq FROM events) SELECT seq, next_seq FROM c WHERE next_seq IS NOT NULL AND next_seq != seq+1 LIMIT 50;"
# find duplicates
sqlite3 ledger.db "SELECT seq, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY seq HAVING COUNT(*)>1 LIMIT 20;"
```

lia_devops: I also inspected the collector config they shipped: edge-collector v1.3.7, ack-mode=optimistic, replay.max_age_seconds=86400 (default). That combination + a crash during disk pressure can lead to gateway acks accepted but not persisted locally. If replay later doesn't dedupe (seqs changed or suppressed), you get divergence.

jess_support: Customer confirms they use optimistic ack mode. They restarted collector mid-window. They uploaded raw event samples for random seqs around the gaps.

sam_sre: Hypothesis: gateway accepted N events during transient, marked them acked, but due to optimistic ack the collector didn't fsync before responding. On restart those events were not in ledger. Later the gateway saw replays (or downstream routed duplicates) and our billing ingestion saw the full set, so invoice has more tokens than ledger. Duplicate suppression was skipped because some replayed events had new meta (or seq IDs reissued).

lia_devops: Mitigations and next actions: 
- Ask customer to upgrade to edge-collector >= 1.4.2 (contains flush-on-ack and improved dedupe).
- If upgrade not immediate: set ack-mode=strict and EDGE_COLLECTOR_FORCE_FLUSH=true to reduce risk.
- Run ledger reconciliation tool to correlate audit rows to ledger rows and flag missing seq windows prior to issuing billing adjustments.

tom_billing: For customer-facing next steps I'll draft: provisional credit = delta_tokens * unit_rate + note on invoice. Need SRE confirmation of root cause before final adjustment.

jess_support: I've started a short internal runbook entry for on-prem customers with disk-pressure cases and included the SQL snippets and config changes. I'll coordinate the upgrade window with the customer; they prefer a maintenance slot tomorrow 01:00-02:00 UTC.

sam_sre: If they upgrade, verify counts after upgrade with a small smoke test: generate 10k tokens, restart, and verify ledger and billing ingestion match. Script: 
```
# smoke
rw-loadgen --target collector --tokens 10000 --tag smoke-20260311
# verify
rw-usage-recon --filter tag=smoke-20260311 --sum-tokens
```

lia_devops: Also add collector.persist_failures > 0 alert to the support SLOs and page on sustained failures for >5m. That should catch similar incidents earlier.

jess_support: I'll keep this thread updated. Customer accepted provisional credit offer while we confirm root cause. Will post final reconciliation once ledger vs audit re-run completes after the upgrade. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

+replay_bot: Automated note: reconciliation_job_1793456789 queued for run after artifacts validation.
